method: Machado et al. 2009 full-severity linear-RGB channel arithmetic; grayscale uses relative luminance.
legacy_warning_diagnosis: Platform batched matrix multiplication emitted floating-point warnings for finite RGB inputs. Explicit scalar channel arithmetic removes the warning path. Legacy and corrected outputs agree within floating-point rounding on every pixel checked; no source figure or statistical output changed.

rendered_review.finding: Across the three colour-vision simulations, treatment identity remains interpretable through the fixed shared legend and colour/lightness differences. Pure grayscale brings dupi and abro 200 mg close together; overlapping curves cannot reliably be identified by shade alone. This is a colour-first figure, not certified for grayscale-only reading.
rendered_review.decision: Retain consistent colour encoding and legend; do not claim universal grayscale distinguishability. A grayscale-only publication would require direct group labels or a separate accessible version.
